title: BACKYARD / STONE
description: First follow-up convo with Kim where you discover keys under the stone.

dialogueTree.speaker: Stone -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: A stone like any other, lying in a whorl of sleet and mud. Maybe there's something under it?
dialogueTree.polish: Kamień jak każdy inny. Leży na kupie śniegu i błota. Może coś pod nim jest?
dialogueTree.belarusian: Звычайны камень, што ляжыць у віры са слякоты і бруду. Можа, пад ім нешта ёсць?

links.speaker: Stone -> N/A
links.english: There's a key beneath it, rusty from the dirt.
links.polish: Pod spodem leży zardzewiały od błota klucz.
links.belarusian: Пад ім ляжыць ключ, заржавелы ад бруду.

links.speaker: Kim Kitsuragi -> N/A
links.english: "This must be for the front door. Pity it doesn't have the apartment number on it. This building has many apartments and the man can be in any of them..."
links.polish: „To musi być klucz do drzwi wejściowych. Szkoda, że nie ma na nim numeru mieszkania. W tym budynku jest wiele apartamentów, a ten mężczyzna może mieszkać w każdym z nich...”
links.belarusian: "Гэта, мусіць, ад уваходных дзвярэй. Шкада, што на ім няма нумара кватэры. У гэтым будынку шмат кватэр, і той чалавек можа быць у любой з іх..."

links.speaker: You -> N/A
links.english: "How are we going to find the right one?"

links.speaker: Kim Kitsuragi -> N/A
links.english: "We'll just have to go in and see."
links.polish: „Będziemy musieli wejść do środka i się przekonać”.

links.speaker: Kim Kitsuragi -> N/A
links.english: "This must be for the front door. Let's see if it works."
links.polish: „To musi być klucz do drzwi wejściowych. Sprawdźmy, czy zadziała”.
links.belarusian: "Гэта, мусіць, ад уваходных дзвярэй. Давайце праверым, ці падыдзе ён."

links.speaker: Logic -> N/A
links.english: Looks like it could belong to the building's front door.
links.polish: Zdaje się, że może otwierać drzwi wejściowe budynku.
links.belarusian: Падобна, што ён ад уваходных дзвярэй будынка.
